tags: Short looping videos posted on Divine (divine.video), including classic Vines restored from the Vine archive. Each item links to the video file on Divine's media server. The videos belong to their creators.
Title as the creator posted it
Playable MP4 of the video, e.g. https://media.divine.video/<sha256>.mp4
Still image shown before the video plays
Creator's display name. For classic Vines, the name on the original Vine account

Nostr account that posted the video, npub form. Divine creates it behind an email sign-in, so the creator may never have seen it. For classic Vines it is the archive account Divine holds until the original creator claims it
Creator's verified address, e.g. alice@divine.video. Included only when it resolves to creator-npub at the time of listing
The video's id on Divine, the d tag of its kind 34236 event: the file hash for native videos, the original Vine id for classic Vines
SHA-256 hash of the video file, its address on Blossom media servers
Date first posted, YYYY-MM-DD. For classic Vines, the original Vine upload date
Width x height in pixels, e.g. 1080x1920
divine for videos posted on Divine, vine for classic Vines restored from the archive
Original Vine user id, classic Vines only
Loop count on Vine when the archive was taken, classic Vines only
Like count on Vine when the archive was taken, classic Vines only
Spoken or written language, ISO 639-1 code
Divine's capture check result, e.g. verified_mobile or verified_web
